harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a dedicated node2 uploader key and node1 forced-command ingest identity. Each SSH submission is stored byte-for-byte as a separate atomic receipt. Commands, shells, PTYs, and forwarding are blocked. Existing data, RHEL 9.8, and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were preserved. Both nodes passed one-at-a-time reboot persistence testing.
actions_performed: Created uploader and its ED25519 key on node2
Created the locked-password ingest account and atomic receipt handler on node1
Restricted the key by source address, forced command, and OpenSSH restrict options
Applied account-scoped sshd restrictions without changing administrative SSH policy
Verified byte-exact ingestion and negative security behaviors
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery

evidence.requirement: Restricted application identity is separate from administrative access
evidence.summary: Matching key fingerprints connect node2’s uploader to node1’s ingest account. Ingest has forced-command/public-key-only policy, while root retains normal SSH behavior.

evidence.requirement: Newline-delimited submissions are stored byte-for-byte as separate files
evidence.summary: The initial source and receipt have identical SHA-256 9640b5ca… and identical displayed bytes; each completed connection has its own receipt.

evidence.requirement: The key cannot run arbitrary commands, obtain a shell/PTY, or establish forwarding
evidence.summary: Remote command returned 126, PTY and forwarding attempts returned 255, shell syntax was stored literally, and no command side-effect files appeared.

evidence.requirement: Existing receipt and sample batch were preserved
evidence.summary: Initial and final hashes remain 86621346… for sample-batch.txt and 93cb8c09… for received/prior.txt.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel were preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 before and after restart.
Boot ID changed from 910dc564-… to 2a1143db-…. SSH policy, service state, stored data, and a fresh authenticated byte-exact submission were verified after recovery.
Boot ID changed from 555221a1-… to cc49b6f8-…. The uploader key and fingerprint persisted, and a fresh post-restart submission produced the exact expected receipt on node1.
